title: Lieu Foh Sun

page_data.en:
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

（批：799 0M）
Shanghai Municipal Council.

December 21st 1916.

Sir,
General Yang is prepared to hand over his duties
to a temporary successor but no instructions have
been so far received from Peking.
On the 20th inst many of the prominent gentry and
merchants paid a visit of condolence to General.
They were received by staff officers, the General
not being present.
General Lu of Woosung visited Lunghwa yesterday
and stayed from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. During his stay he
had an interview with General Yang.
About 70 merchants held a meeting at the Book
Guild in the Chinese City yesterday to discuss
ways and means to raise a Volunteer Corps.
The so-called rebels under the leadership of
Lieu roh Sun □□□ still continue to hold meetings
at the Zee Oon □□ teashop Rue Wagner, Frenchtown.
Another meeting will be held at 4 p.m. to-day.
It now appears that for each name placed on the list
for presentation to General Li in claiming
money and tickets, a charge of five cents was made
and it has now been raised to ten cents.
Many have not yet paid and a notice has been posted
at the teashop stating that the names of persons
who have not yet paid will be removed from the list.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmmmmmmmm
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
（印：上海工部局）
警务处。
（侦探股）

（批：799 0M）
上海工部局。

1916年12月21日。

先生：
杨将军准备将职务移交给一位临时继任者，但迄今尚未收到来自北京的指示。
本月20日，许多绅商名流前往慰问杨将军。
他们由参谋人员接待，杨将军本人不在场。
吴淞的卢将军昨日访问龙华，停留时间为上午10时至下午4时。在此期间，他会见了杨将军。
约70名商人昨日在南市书业公会举行会议，讨论筹组民团的方法与途径。
所谓由孙□□□领导的叛乱分子，仍在法租界华格纳路（Rue Wagner）的紫云□□茶馆继续集会。
今日下午4时将举行另一次会议。
目前看来，在向李将军申领钱款和票证而列入名单的每个姓名，原收取五分钱费用，现已涨至一角钱。
许多人尚未付款，茶馆内已张贴告示，称未付款者的姓名将从名单中除名。

您顺从的仆人，
mmmmmmmmmm
总探长。

警察总监
